name: Ending
notes: The last words after the Hollow Vessel falls; then back to the title.

lines.text: THE HOLLOW VESSEL FALLS. THE GLARE POURS OUT OF ITS BROKEN MASK... AND INTO YOU.
YOU HOLD IT. NO MIND TO BURN, NO VOICE TO CRY OUT. ONLY VOID.
THE TEMPLE SEALS AGAIN, WITH A NEW VESSEL INSIDE. FAR ABOVE, IN DUSTMERE, THE LAMPS STILL GLOW.
THANK YOU FOR PLAYING VOID VESSEL!
